package.name: forklift_perception
package.description: Camera perception for the forklift: station signs, floor and bay lanes, bullseye alignment targets, parcels and seals, load check. A ROS-free core (camera model, detectors) with thin ROS nodes on top. Uses only what a real robot has: images, camera_info, TF, joint states. It never reads simulator poses or world layout files (docs/PLAN_CV_AUTONOMY.md, R1/R2).
